title: Point to another URL
summary: FastAPI: Point to another URL. Inspect the first 302 response.
introduction: RedirectResponse sends a Location header. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
learningObjectives: Point to another URL with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Point to another URL

blocks.text: RedirectResponse sends /hello as the location. The browser makes a second request to it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Choose the redirect status deliberately, especially for non-GET methods.
